_comment: Non-secret config for the ICL console proxy -- Create ICL Request, Create Deposit,
Allocate Bank and Approve/Reject ICL Request, all served as static pages by this one proxy.
the password is read from the environment variable named below, falling back to the gitignored
.claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root (same value the MCP servers use).
The 'services' block is deliberately IDENTICAL across every web/*-console: each console's
proxy exposes all four services at /api/ottk/*, /api/dttk/*, /api/dealid/* and /api/tf/*,
so a page can reach any of them without its console being re-wired first. An unused route
costs nothing (no session is opened until the first call to that key). No ICL OData service
is wired up yet -- every screen in this console runs on its own sample data until that layer
Port 8772 keeps this server clear of ottk-dttk-console (8765), dttk-console (8766), deal-id-console (8767),
